news.headline: US judge blocks deportation of DoorDash driver shot by ICE
news.summary: The delivery driver was transferred from a hospital to a detention centre after the shooting on Sunday.

news.headline: Kamala Harris campaigns with Abdul El-Sayed to unify Democratic voters
news.summary: The former vice president joins Abdul El-Sayed in Detroit to bolster Democratic unity in swing-state Michigan.

news.headline: Pentagon Showcases Dozens of Advanced Energy Projects
news.summary: More than 100 exhibits related to energy innovation are on display at the Pentagon, including the Army's Tactical Microgrid Standard, the Navy's system to use microwaves to beam limitless power from space and the Air Force's Modular Energy for Tactical Expeditionary Operations Resource system.
